recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Do not patch retained Media source or historical generated release metadata in the current build; if HL7 maintains an R4/R4B errata source for Media, the target reference should be Reference(Device|DeviceMetric).
issue_request: FHIR-30633 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised for R4 and applied for R5. It reported that the R4 Media.device eligible reference types listed Device twice.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-30633. The duplicate appears to have originated when commit 7fbb1fff1d9f70f28eb68f4d1251aa670bc889bc replaced DeviceComponent with Device in Media.device, resulting in Reference(Device|DeviceMetric|Device). Media had already been removed from the active build by the Media-to-DocumentReference merge before the Jira was filed.
additional_context: FHIR-23567 merged Media into DocumentReference for R5, and commit 5c62f91cd81f150be72ad506c876e3cc20bd631d removed media=Media from source/fhir.ini's active [resources] list. source/history.html records Media as removed after R4B with DocumentReference or Observation replacements. The current successor DocumentReference.author targetProfile list includes Device only once. Related FHIR-26454 and 2025 OO minutes resolved the broader targetProfile uniqueness request as overcome by events because DocumentReference.author only has one Device reference.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml would touch a retained, inactive resource rather than a current build artifact, and the active successor source does not carry the duplicate Device target.

related_jiras.note: Merged Media into DocumentReference for R5 and removed Media from active build scope, making the R4 Media.device correction obsolete for current core.
Raised from the same Media.device duplicate discussion as a tooling uniqueness request; later resolved No Change because DocumentReference.author has only one Device reference.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive technical correction reported that R4 Media.device listed Device twice and was applied for R5.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed request and original R4 Media target artifact.

evidence_items.summary: The retained Media spreadsheet still defines Media.device as Reference(Device|DeviceMetric|Device).
evidence_items.learned: The reported duplicate exists only in retained Media source, not in active current-build resource source.

evidence_items.summary: Current fhir.ini active resources omit Media, and history records Media as removed after R4B with DocumentReference or Observation as replacements.
evidence_items.learned: source/media is not the correct current-build target for a source edit.

evidence_items.summary: 7fbb1fff changed Media.device from Reference(Device|DeviceMetric|DeviceComponent) to Reference(Device|DeviceMetric|Device); 5c62f91cd8 removed media=Media from active fhir.ini resources during the Media-to-DocumentReference merge.
evidence_items.learned: The duplicate predates the seed issue, and later build scope removed Media before a current-source edit was needed.

evidence_items.summary: DocumentReference.author targetProfiles include Device only once among the listed target profiles.
evidence_items.learned: The active successor resource does not reproduce the duplicate Device target.

evidence_items.summary: Participants identified Media.device's repeated Device target; Grahame Grieve said duplicate target profiles are not valid, and Eric Haas said DeviceComponent had been changed to Device instead of being removed.
evidence_items.learned: Community evidence confirms the duplicate's origin and invalidity without requiring an inactive-source edit.

evidence_items.summary: The broader targetProfile uniqueness request raised from the same duplicate was resolved No Change as overcome by events because DocumentReference.author only has one Device reference.
evidence_items.learned: Later WG disposition supports treating the retired Media duplicate as obsolete for current core source.

evidence_items.summary: OO minutes record rejecting FHIR-26454 as overcome by events, with the note that DocumentReference.author only has one Device reference.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence aligns with using the successor DocumentReference source rather than editing removed Media source.

evidence_items.locator: Idempotency and negative community searches for FHIR-30633
